patch_description: The current program has regressed by disabling the GF_SND_SSTHRESH listener that was crucial in the best-performing generation (5527.07). This edit re-enables SSTHRESH monitoring with MINMAX listener and reintroduces the congestion phase detection logic that checks when CWND has collapsed below SSTHRESH * 1.5. This captures sustained congestion more precisely than loss alone - when CWND is stuck below the slow-start threshold, it indicates the connection is in congestion avoidance mode rather than experiencing transient packet loss. The additional +2000 bonus during sustained congestion stacks with existing loss-triggered bonuses, providing stronger working set protection when the network is genuinely degraded.
